author: Multiplayer Everything
name: Flash Chess

steps: Press Play online. A message shows your room code; send it to your friend. The game starts once they have joined.
Your friends type the code in Join by code, or pick your room in the Rooms list.
The host picks Shallow or Deep on the title screen and clicks RESTART. Only the player whose turn it is can move.

keys.does: Click a piece, then a lit square.

tips: If your friend leaves, the computer plays red again.
New: clicks in real game windows haven't been tested yet, nor two PCs or the internet. Tell us how it runs.
Everyone needs the same Ruffle Together build and game file; the launcher keeps them current.

description: Flash Chess (Digital Vision Multimedia, 2002): play chess against a friend instead of the computer. The host is blue and moves first.
